name: Inventory Tools
description: Client-side helpers that make big inventories bearable.

pages.title: Inventory Tools
pages.text: Client-side helpers that make big inventories bearable. **Inventory Profiles Next** sorts and moves items. **Mouse Tweaks** speeds up mouse use. **Shulker Box Tooltip** previews contents. Settings are in the Mods menu.

pages.title: Inventory Profiles Next
pages.text: Sorts inventories with a button or key, moves matching stacks and locks slots. Auto-refill is off in this pack; turn it on in its config screen.

pages.title: Shulker Box Tooltip
pages.text: Hover a shulker box to see what is inside.

**Mouse Tweaks** adds drag-split: hold click and drag over slots to spread a stack. Scroll the wheel over a slot to move items between inventories. \
